Palestine
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Cairo, Egypt andthe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Amman, Jordan.
Visa is required for all types of travel documents for citizens of BiH:
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the State of Palestine are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina are not recommended to travel to Palestine, especially to the Gaza Strip. There have been no conflicts in the West Bank so far, but it is still recommended not to travel to the West Bank unless absolutely necessary. Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina who are in this country can, in case of need, contact the embassies of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Amman (Jordan) or Cairo (Egypt), with the given details of name and surname, address of residence in BiH, BiH travel document number, and place of residence in Palestine, as well as with the necessary contact information, in order to find a way to provide support.
Contact telephone numbers of the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Cairo: (landline): + (2) 02 374 99 191; contact telephone numbers (mobile phones) of employees at the Embassy are: Ambassador Dr. Sabit Subašić: +(2) 0103 047 1902; Minister Advisor Armin Limo: +(2) 0101 767 3304; Second Secretary Alma Šahinović: +(2) 0109 751 1726; technical secretary Nourhan Zidan: +(2) 0122 862 2250.Contact numbers of the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Amman: + (962 6) 58 56 921; + (962 6) 58 56 924; Email: amman@bhembassyjo.com.It is also possible to contact the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bosnia and Herzegovina via phone number: +387 33 281 234 and e-mail: emergency@mvp.gov.ba.
